links.comparator_used: Other algorithm recall levels (5-100%) judged against a purely statistical or unconstrained operating point, within a $100,000/QALY willingness-to-pay threshold
links.outcome: Cost-effectiveness (ICER per QALY gained) across recall levels, used to identify the optimal cutpoint
links.effect: ML-enabled screening was cost-effective (ICER < $100k/QALY) for recall levels up to 30%; the optimal recall level was 30% with a mean ICER of $94,022/QALY gained
links.tradeoff: Low precision at the optimal recall level (0.27%); higher recall levels exceeded the willingness-to-pay threshold
links.quote: The optimal recall level was 30% (Precision 0.27%), which resulted in a mean ICER of $94,022/QALY gained.
